How a Race Condition Happens

How a Race Condition Happens

Asha and Ben tap the last free seat, C3, at the same moment. Without a lock, both apps see C3 as free, both take the payment, and two people turn up for one seat. With a lock, Asha's tap holds C3 while she pays, so Ben is told it's taken and books C4. The whole fix is one rule: check and book must be one step.

#computerscience #concurrency #coding #interview #tryalgoviz

Load Balancer vs Reverse Proxy vs API Gateway

Load Balancer vs Reverse Proxy vs API Gateway

All three sit in front of your servers, but each does a different job. A load balancer reads the load on 3 identical copies of the same app and sends every request to the least busy one. A reverse proxy is one app's front door: it unlocks HTTPS, keeps a copy of each page, and answers repeats from its cache so the app never even knows. An API gateway is one door to many services: no login gets a 401, /photos and /cart go to different services, and more than 5 requests a second get a 429 before the services ever see them. Balancer spreads. Proxy guards. Gateway routes.

Friend's phone unpacks it in reverse: 7 layers to pack it, 7 to unpack it.
